name: De Anza Boulevard
source: SUMO; synthetic hidden-world demand; VTA 2024 is project motivation, not this demand; held-out simulation seed 200; baseline is modeled stale timing, not verified city timing. Headline: all-requested delay score (900 s unfinished/teleport charge). Approach: incoming-edge time loss/visit; queue: stopped vehicles each second; AoG/PCD: first entry within 5 m of stop bar. Split failures: queue at both green and yellow onset, through movements (any movement if no through link). Green timings: configured maxima; distance: projected first-to-last signal span. Stops: completed-trip mean waitingCount. Travel: complete mainline end-to-end traversals, actual entry-time bins, excluding teleports; direction keys follow road axis. Emissions: HBEFA4/PC_petrol_Euro-4 default model, probability 1; cohort totals including inserted unfinished trips, CO2 mg to kg, volumetric fuel ml to L; uninserted trips emit zero.
